call_points.text: Wage hike effective July for all associates; full impact 170-200 bps, about half in Q2.
Management maintains 15%-plus EBITDA margin target despite investments.
Manufacturing and E&U softness to continue for a couple more quarters; E&U turnaround expected from Q3.
Unbilled revenue at March 2026 was higher than expected due to delayed documentation; regularized in Q1.
No numeric revenue guidance; management cites market volatility.
No FY27 revenue guidance; management says it cannot predict which quarter growth returns.
Q4 margin had 340 bps of one-offs: 170 bps forex and 170 bps from provision reversals and lower ESOP.
About 200 bps of FY26 growth was lost from exiting low-margin, non-strategic deals.
Sales headcount to rise 30-40% YoY by mid-FY27; already hired leaders for ERP, data/AI, and Lifesciences.
Board proposed final dividend of ₹4 per share, taking FY26 total to ₹6.50 per share.
Management acknowledged six quarters without growth and said earlier leadership hires did not deliver.
Larger players are bidding for mid-sized deals as AI levels the playing field, raising competitive intensity.
AI deals require upfront productivity commitments, causing near-term revenue deflation.
Life Sciences MedTech client operational issue caused the biggest vertical degrowth; management believes it is behind.

operating_notes.text: Q4 TCV was $208 million, up 3% QoQ and second consecutive quarter above $200 million.
DSO rose to 62 days from 55 days adjusted for April collections.
About 200 bps of FY26 growth was lost from exiting low-margin, non-strategic deals.
Q1FY27 TCV signings were $168.7 million, up 20% YoY, with AI-led engagements across US financial services, European banking and pharma.
Active accounts were about 213 at Q1FY27; the top 36 accounts contribute 80% of business.
DSO improved to 55 days in Q1FY27; OCF to EBITDA was 108%.

timeline.summary: On 6 May 2026 Birlasoft reported Q4FY26 revenue flat QoQ at ₹1,348.6 Cr and FY26 revenue down 1.2% to ₹5,310 Cr; management gave no FY27 revenue guidance.

On 28 July 2026, Birlasoft's Q1FY27 earnings call reported revenue of ₹1,379.4 Cr (up 2.3% QoQ), EBITDA margin of 16.1%, and TCV signings of $168.7 mn, with management guiding to a 15%-plus margin and a 29-30% FY27 tax rate.
